summary: The urge to blow up the arrangement may be strongest right before you have figured out what you want instead.
body: The urge to blow up the arrangement may be strongest right before you have figured out what you want instead. When Uranus squares Lilith, a restriction you have tolerated for too long can suddenly become unbearable, and the first available exit may look better simply because it is an exit. The anger may be pointing to a necessary change. It does not have to choose the timing, wording, or method for you. Before you quit, expose, cancel, or cut someone off, decide which part of the situation actually needs to end and what you still want intact afterward.
